nodes.label: Consent Feature Module
nodes.rationale: Dedicated module favored over extending User Management to adhere to SOLID/SRP and ISP principles, separating consent lifecycle from profile CRUD.

nodes.label: Append-only Consent Records
nodes.rationale: Single append-only table (CookieConsentRecords) satisfies both current state and audit history (FR-016) without a separate audit system, adhering to DRY/KISS/YAGNI.
